diagnostics.title: Detailed diagnostics for this session
diagnostics.policy: Enabled by default for all sessions. Conversation content, tool arguments, and tool output are stored locally for 14 days. Content is limited to 64 MiB per session and 1 GiB across all sessions; the oldest content is removed first when the limit is reached. Hidden model reasoning is not collected. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
diagnostics.privacy: Credentials are filtered, but content may still include personal information and research results. You can disable or clear it at any time. Re-enabling takes effect with the next submission and does not backfill previous conversations.
diagnostics.clearDescription: This disables detailed diagnostics and clears this session’s detailed content from this device. Runtime metadata is retained. Previously exported ZIP files cannot be recalled.
diagnostics.acceptClear: I confirm clearing this session’s detailed content
diagnostics.empty: No content is currently available. The package contains runtime metadata and markers for missing content only.
diagnostics.retention: The export is a snapshot of the evidence at this moment and does not expire automatically. Keep the ZIP or the entire extracted directory, including manifest.json. The holder is responsible for its storage and deletion.
diagnostics.acceptSave: I understand that diagnostics include detailed content. I confirm saving it and will decide whether to share it with a developer.
diagnostics.enabled: Enabled. Recording starts with the next submission; the current turn will not be backfilled.
diagnostics.disabled: Disabled. No further content will be collected. Existing content remains until it expires or is manually cleared.
diagnostics.cleared: Detailed content has been cleared from this device. Basic runtime records are retained.
diagnostics.saved: Detailed diagnostics saved. Nothing was uploaded.
diagnostics.coverage: Submissions covered: {{submissions}} · ZIP approximately {{size}} KiB · Truncated blocks: {{blocks}}
diagnostics.noGaps: No content gaps marked; this does not imply all upstream content is visible
